remarks: Freshly painted and professionally cleaned, industrial loft with exposed beams, wood and brick, 149 Water Street welcomes you. This stunning one-bedroom urban home is situated in the trendy and vibrant SoNo neighborhood, just steps away from the SoNo Collection Mall, parks, beaches, nightlife, coffee shops, shopping, and top-rated restaurants. Conveniently located near I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, and within walking distance of the South Norwalk Train Station, this airy and welcoming home boasts soaring 15+ foot ceilings, a large wall of sunny windows, and beautiful hardwood flooring. Additional features include private deck, reserved parking and additional parking at no cost, an in-unit washer/dryer, and central air conditioning. The open-concept living space is perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The spacious bedroom offers a tranquil retreat. Experience the dynamic energy of SoNo right outside your door. With its eclectic mix of shops, dining options, and cultural attractions, there's always something new to discover. Whether you're enjoying a coffee at a local cafe, strolling through nearby parks, or experiencing the nightlife, SoNo has it all. Discover why 149 Water Street in SoNo should be your new home. Please note there is a Move In/Out Fee and Processing Fee.
